title: Weakly Supervised Seafloor Segmentation for Seagrass Habitat Mapping in Side-Scan Sonar Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2608.24756v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Seagrass meadows are crucial blue-carbon habitats, and mapping their extent is a prerequisite for coastal management and carbon inventory. Optical satellite sensors cover large areas but cannot reach deep or turbid water, whereas side-scan sonar (SSS) images the seabed at high resolution and at any depth. Interpreting SSS, however, still relies on dense manual annotation, which is slow and costly. We address this by adapting a weakly supervised semantic segmentation framework to SSS benthic habitat mapping, so that pixel-level maps are learned from image-level labels alone. The framework couples a ViT-based encoder-decoder with a classification branch, extracts class activation maps, and refines them into pseudo-labels with a dense conditional random field that we tune for the noise and weak boundaries of acoustic imagery. translated_title: 基于弱监督的侧扫声纳图像海草栖息地测绘海底分割
translated_abstract: 海草床是关键的蓝碳栖息地，绘制其分布范围是沿海管理和碳核算的前提。光学卫星传感器覆盖面积大，但无法深入浑浊或深水区域，而侧扫声纳（SSS）能以高分辨率在任何深度成像海底。然而，解读SSS图像仍依赖密集的人工标注，这既缓慢又昂贵。我们通过将弱监督语义分割框架适应于SSS海底栖息地测绘来解决这一问题，使得仅凭图像级标签即可学习像素级地图。该框架将基于ViT的编码器-解码器与分类分支相结合，提取类激活图，并通过针对声学图像噪声和弱边界调优的密集条件随机场将其细化为伪标签。它采用迭代自训练方案，并结合采样策略以应对严重的类别不平衡问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种弱监督语义分割框架，仅利用图像级标签即可实现侧扫声纳图像中海草栖息地的像素级分割，通过类激活图、调优的条件随机场和迭代自训练，克服了声学图像噪声和类别不平衡的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a weakly supervised semantic segmentation framework that learns pixel-level seagrass habitat maps from image-level labels alone in side-scan sonar imagery, leveraging class activation maps, tuned dense CRF, and iterative self-training to address acoustic noise and class imbalance.
